source: proofs/lem-compcb-rectangular-product (af-validated 2026-07-24, 12/12 taint clean). FULL VALIDATED CONTRACT: Uniform rectangular compressed-product estimate: there are universal C_co < infinity and e_co > 0 such that, for e=delta+epsilon <= e_co, every compatible amplified rectangular pair satisfies ||A dot B-AB|| <= C_co*e*||A||||B||. Compatibility quantifies A in S_{P_m,Q_m} and B in S_{Q_m,R_m} inside one square amplification M_m tensor A.
